== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|An [[emerald]] rose from the center of the flames and acted as a guide.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c1">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[emerald]] is described as shining like a star and hovering in the air.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[emerald]] is hot enough to feel like it would burn [[Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine]] through her skirt.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c1" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
